title: Hot Stuff Club
body: Price chose his company with care. He founded the Hot Stuff Club in 1970, but is reluctant to discuss its activities. Few architects have been granted membership of this exclusive cabal, characterised by its eccentric sartorial and dietary rules (members were given badges made from the caps of old-fashioned mustard pots and mustard was always on the table at meetings) and encouragement of witty conversation and wicked gossip. Price had architect friends, Norman Foster, for example, and former assistant Will Alsop, "but we rarely talk about architecture".
subtitle: “Exclusive Cabal”
